summary: Enterprise finance customer evaluating Redwood Private (VPC) for production inference. Heavy security and residency requirements; vendor risk intake in progress.
notes:
Sales + security thread notes (shorthand):
- Primary ask: Private VPC deployment with customer-managed KMS (BYOK) and EU data residency option for training caches and logs.
- Security team sent vendor risk intake: requested SIG/CSC/CAIQ + SOC2 report + pen test summary. Received initial CAIQ answers 2026-02-20, incremental evidence pending.
- Networking: must support VPC peering with restrictive egress, no public IPs for inferencing nodes, outbound only via NAT gateway under customer controls. Customer requests diagram with subnet/IP ranges and required firewall rules.
- KMS: require AWS KMS CMKs or Azure Key Vault HSM with key rotation log. Ask: will Redwood allow BYOK import and HSM-backed keys for model state + artifact encryption? Follow-up with eng: yes for Private VPC; hosted requires dedicated contract.
- Audit logging: retention requested 1 year minimum, immutable audit trail, delivery via S3 (EU) + optional SIEM push (Splunk/Datadog). Security asked about log schema (token-level redaction) — Redwood to provide sample log schema.
- Data residency: primary processing region EU-west, backups must not leave EU unless explicit consent. Legal: DPA redline around subprocessor list and cross-border flow.
- Shared responsibility: security wants explicit matrix mapping network controls, OS patching, host hardening, access control, and key custody. Draft sent 2026-03-01; customer made edits on boundary for control plane.
- Procurement: finance asked for committed capacity pricing for Dedicated vs Private license. Initial ARR range estimate provided.
- Quote: included optional 24/7 SRE support + extended observability add-on.
- Customer quote: "We need to see a completed SIG pack and a runbook for breach handling before legal will sign."
- Next demo: run network walkthrough + show KMS BYOK flow; aim to start POC (3 node) wk of 2026-03-22.
- Open evidence: pen-test report redacted, incident history, ISO attestation. SE owning evidence collection: Riley. Legal contact: Elena Marquez (Glacier).
